about_the_game:
About This Game

This is a pixel-art, top-down action-adventure game that tells a story of courage and self-overcoming. You will play as a young girl deeply troubled by social anxiety, for whom the simple act of "going out" is an all-out battle that requires every ounce of her strength.

  • A Long-Awaited Meetup

After a long time chatting online, she has finally mustered the courage to meet her online friends in person for the first time. What should be an exciting journey is fraught with peril, as years of built-up anxiety, fear, and self-doubt manifest as monstrous creatures, blocking her path at every turn. The moment she steps out the door, a war against her own inner demons begins.

  • Turn Fear Into Strength

In this game, you'll engage in fast-paced, top-down combat. Each level represents both a real-world location and a psychological challenge. You must wield your weapon to defeat all enemies born from negative emotions and clear the room to safely advance to the next area and move the story forward.

The enemies you face might be the childhood fear of a vicious dog, the hesitation to speak with a stranger, or the feeling of being overwhelmed in a crowd. Each will attack you in its own unique way. Only by confronting and defeating them one by one can you help her get closer to her final destination.

Features

An Emotional & Relatable Story: Centered on the theme of social anxiety, delve into a young girl's inner world and experience a unique journey of self-challenge and growth.

Fast-Paced, Room-Clearing Combat: Engage in satisfying, easy-to-learn combat against hordes of "inner demons." Enjoy the thrill of clearing the screen and the achievement of conquering your fears.

Story-Driven Level Design: Each level is deeply connected to the protagonist's emotional journey. Combat is more than just a challenge—it's the key to progressing the narrative and unlocking new chapters of her story.

Can you help her overcome her inner self, bravely step out the door, and finally embrace the friendship she has longed for? Her journey is now in your hands.

name: Bound by the Everyday
short_description: This is a top-down action-adventure game about courage. As someone with social anxiety, every step outside feels like a battle. Wield your weapon and fight through waves of negative emotion monsters in a manifested inner world, striving for a long-awaited meeting.
